name: En Dor
overview: En Dor is a city associated with the tribe of Manasseh, as noted in Joshua 17:11, where it is listed among the towns within their territory. It is also famously known as the location where King Saul sought out a woman with a familiar spirit to summon the prophet Samuel's spirit, despite having previously condemned such practices (1 Samuel 28:7-11). This event highlights the spiritual desperation of Saul and underscores the biblical prohibition against necromancy, while situating En Dor as a significant setting in Israel's history.
